source.exact_excerpt:
I2.1.2.2 The ship displacement DUI is the displacement, in kt, of the ship corresponding to the
            upper ice waterline (UIWL). Where multiple waterlines are used for determining the UIWL, the
            displacement is to be determined from the waterline corresponding to the greatest
            displacement.

scope: Select maximum displacement among represented waterline cases; not physical measurement or whole-waterline geometry.

Constraint Violation in SPARQLConstraintComponent (http://www.w3.org/ns/shacl#SPARQLConstraintComponent):
	Severity: sh:Violation
	Source Shape: nltl:ShipUpperIceWaterlineShape
	Focus Node: <urn:nltlv2:development:subject>
	Value Node: <urn:nltlv2:development:subject>
	Source Constraint: [ sh:message Literal("The upper ice waterline displacement must equal the greatest represented waterline case displacement, in canonical kilotonnes.") ; sh:select Literal("
            SELECT $this
            WHERE {
                $this nltl:upperIceWaterlineDisplacement ?result .
                ?result qudt:numericValue ?resultValue ;
                        qudt:unit <http://qudt.org/vocab/unit/KiloTON_Metric> .
                FILTER (
                    NOT EXISTS {
                        $this nltl:hasUpperIceWaterlineCase ?case .

                        ?caseQuantity qudt:numericValue ?caseValue ;
                                      qudt:unit <http://qudt.org/vocab/unit/KiloTON_Metric> .
                        FILTER (?caseValue = ?resultValue)
                    }

                        $this nltl:hasUpperIceWaterlineCase ?greaterCase .
                        ?greaterCase nltl:waterlineCaseDisplacement ?greaterQuantity .
                        ?greaterQuantity qudt:numericValue ?greaterValue ;
                                         qudt:unit <http://qudt.org/vocab/unit/KiloTON_Metric> .
                        FILTER (?greaterValue > ?resultValue)
                    }
                )
            }
        ") ]
